# Capsule UI Kit router
Entry: ../README.md
Install and run: ../docs/GETTING_STARTED.md
Register a capsule: ../docs/REGISTER_CAPSULE_TYPES.md
Exact file lookup: catalogue/routes.tsv
Nodes: catalogue/kit.nodes.jsonl
Coverage and source hashes: catalogue/coverage.json
Ranked lookup: python3 kit/tools/route_v2.py (see kit/docs/router_web.md)
Regenerate: python3 ../tools/router_index.py
Verify: python3 ../tools/router_index.py --check
